home.metaTitle: Tripas-Coração · Apartments in historic Porto buildings
home.metaDescription: Design-led apartments in historic buildings in central Porto. Book direct for our best rate, flexible cancellation and a local team always close by.
home.heroImageAlt: Living room with tall French windows over the Cordoaria gardens in Porto
home.intro: Over forty apartments in historic buildings across central Porto. We kept the granite façades and the details that tell their story; inside, we started again with Portuguese designers, artists and makers.
home.buildingsTitle: Every house has a story. Choose yours.
home.directBody: Our apartments are on Airbnb and Booking.com too. Here you get our best rate and something the platforms can't give you: us.
home.neighbourhoodsBody: Every building is in the historic centre. Choose your neighbourhood by what you'd like on your doorstep.
home.experiencesTitle: Porto and the Douro, with people who know them.
home.experiencesBody: Walks, tables and boats with the partners we recommend to friends. Tell us what you're after and we'll take care of the rest.
home.experiencesImageAlt: Host showing an illustrated map of Porto inside an apartment
home.ownersTitle: We don't manage properties. We manage assets.
home.ownersBody: Since 2015 we've looked after a limited number of Porto homes, from licence to monthly report. If you own property in the centre, let's talk.
home.statement2: A studio or a family flat.
home.statement4: There’s a Tripas-Coração home for you.
